checks.title: Windows Data Paths
checks.summary: Windows AppData / Roaming path handling exists in helper and GUI startup paths.

checks.title: Windows Shell Integration
checks.summary: Windows shell integration exists for open/reveal path actions.

checks.title: Windows Installer Scaffolding
checks.summary: Windows installer scaffolding exists via Inno Setup and signing hooks.

checks.title: Windows Helper Packaging
checks.summary: PyInstaller packaging only builds the helper app in the macOS branch; Windows packaging currently emits the main app only.

checks.title: Windows Build Validation
checks.summary: Build output validation is macOS-only today; there is no Windows dist/exe validator.

checks.title: Windows Helper Autostart
checks.summary: Helper autostart is implemented for macOS LaunchAgent only; no Windows startup-registration path is tracked in code.

checks.title: Windows Tray Launch Path
checks.summary: Frozen helper tray launch has macOS-specific app-bundle handoff, but no Windows-specific main-app launch path.

checks.title: Hosted Windows Validation
checks.summary: Hosted CI includes a Windows runner for parity reporting.
